title: Oracle · Enterprise engineering
text: Abhinav Reddy Varimalla is an Application Developer at Oracle, Hyderabad, since August 2024. His work includes Java, SQL and PL/SQL enhancements for enterprise utility systems, production troubleshooting and release validation. He built Flexie, an OJET chatbot for FLEX, reducing manual work by 30%.

title: Go · Reliable webhook delivery
text: The Go and PostgreSQL webhook delivery project uses a bounded goroutine worker pool, lease-based crash recovery, exponential-backoff retries, HMAC signing and an idempotent demo receiver. Integration tests cover concurrent job claims, worker crashes and duplicate delivery. A Docker Compose recovery demo exercises failure handling. Retries can lead to repeated delivery attempts; exactly-once delivery is not claimed.
keywords: go golang concurrency concurrent reliability reliable retry retries webhook workers failure failures recovery duplicate

title: AI · Résumé-aware interviewer
text: The résumé-aware AI interviewer uses Python, retrieval-augmented generation and Hugging Face models to generate interview questions across programming, reasoning and domain topics. The project uses PyTorch and Gradio. No model accuracy or evaluation score has been supplied. This is a personal project, not a claim of AI employment at Oracle.

title: Spring · Observability platform

title: This portfolio · AI assistant implementation
text: This portfolio assistant uses LangChain documents, a lexical retriever, a prompt template and ChatOllama. LangGraph orchestrates retrieve, generate, reference-check and abstain nodes. The model runs through Ollama. The reference check validates cited source IDs, not factual entailment. This implementation does not use embeddings, a vector database, CrewAI, persistent conversation memory or autonomous agents.
